snippet.title: Detective Araka - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Store: https://saikeystudios.com/product/detective-araka/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=post
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3443640/Detective_Araka/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=post

In this gripping visual novel, step into the shoes of Yuuki, a boy with amnesia, and team up with top-tier exorcist Ihayase Araka. Together, you must uncover the dark secrets of Inusai Village and piece your forgotten past.
